expectations.evidence: ComponentStore with HashMap<TypeId, ComponentMap> where ComponentMap = HashMap<EntityId, Box<dyn Any>>. Fully type-erased. Adding a component type has zero structural impact.
System trait with run(&self, world: &mut World). Four implementations: MovementSystem, RenderSystem, DamageSystem, AiSystem. Scheduler holds Vec<Box<dyn System>>.
World has generic query methods (query_2, query_3) that return only entities matching component combinations. Systems don't know about unrelated components.
Newtype EntityId(u64) for safety. Components are plain structs — adding one requires no changes to World, ComponentStore, or existing systems.
